distribution: GitHub source and stable release workflow; public package-index upload is intentionally blocked by package metadata. Assurance profiles are distributed in the repository/source archive while the core wheel carries the frontier_assurance package and CLI.
evidence_lifecycle: Deterministic source validation is complemented by release-specific hosted evidence.
interoperability: Versioned core schemas use stable identifiers and root INTERFACES.json separates portable contract identity from FMA application version. Richer domain records map into FMA contracts through explicit adapters while preserving local evidence, calibration, acceptance, and decision semantics. FTQC technical-evidence adoption verifies exact producer schemas/artifacts by SHA-256 and requires explicit reviewed-producer registry entries without importing producer implementations or promoting technical status into consequential authority.
